rules.rule: Read the exact signed-in designer’s current quotation and calculate the proposal in both directions without recording customer confirmation.
rules.source: Approved workbench v10.1 §7.1 and §7.1A on authoritative source costs, strict fixed decimals and last valid amount input.
rules.initialization: A read-only snapshot binds the single quotation and version. Without eligible published technical evidence a new automatic material line does not contribute a trusted complete cost.
rules.dateAndPermission: The original currently assigned designer’s active role determines preview access. The projection makes no time or production state change. Signed IE and merchandiser cannot read this private proposal.
rules.expectation: Signed browsers computed 130% and the precise manual unit price, confirmed no original confirmation-input changes and validated 1165/390px layout, original no-store policy and spacing from the programmatic focus ring.

rules.rule: Stage personal pricing and independent line return, explicit resubmission and resolution behind the joint release boundary.
rules.source: Approved workbench v10.1 §7.2, §7.2A and §13.1 on original field owners, exact versions, independent state and no new writes before joint validation.
rules.initialization: Additive storage starts empty with no backfill. The internal commands use the existing quote transaction and idempotency receipt. No draft or line-review writer is registered before R6.
rules.dateAndPermission: The business clock records exact return and review events. Exact source/round/row/field and the current assigned role are checked, and craft resolution still requires R6.
rules.expectation: The signed app rejects every unregistered new write. Tests of the actual isolated transactions verify idempotent replay, stale draft rejection, one field at a time and no new confirmation, adopted budget or budget row.

rules.rule: Retain existing confirmation, confirmed versions and budget adoption while staging the additive next schema.
rules.source: Approved workbench v10.1 §7.3 and §13.1 on original budget rules and the disabled new confirmation until R6 joint verification.
rules.initialization: Schema 0300 adds storage and a nullable confirmed-basis field. Existing agreements, history and orders remain untouched.
rules.dateAndPermission: No role or existing confirmation/budget write authority changes. The original trusted confirmation time and budget criteria remain operative until the common R6 release.
rules.expectation: A forged next-protocol confirmation is rejected with no persisted effects. Original explicit confirmation, two-tab idempotency, lost-receipt recovery and the existing approved budget and history still pass in real PostgreSQL.
